profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Amazon | MS CS @ Stanford University ’25

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Software Development · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▶ AI-Powered AWS Region Build Automation:

Developed an AI-assisted CLI using AWS kiro-cli to automate deregionalization of AWS CDK IaC for
AWS Billing services and enforce Region Build Automation compliance.

Executed multi-agent workflows using internal MCP tools and RBToD (Region Build Test on Demand)
to validate prerequisites, build, and deploy services in test regions.

▶ Serverless Migration Metrics Microservice:

Owned the design and implementation of a serverless microservice to measure and accelerate AWS
Commerce Platform migration from legacy IaC to AWS CDK.

Unified pipeline metadata across Commerce Platform and company-wide data lakes using AWS Step
Functions, Athena, and Lake Formation, aggregating data for ˜4000 pipelines across ˜600 services.

Implemented Lambda-based enrichment of package artifacts to analyze underlying AWS resources and
automatically validate prerequisite compliance for internal automation solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Software Development · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Full-stack Development of Wikif.ai: Developed an MVP for a generative AI web app called Wikif.ai that used internal documentations to create, update, and maintain internal Amazon wikis.

Generative AI with AWS Bedrock and Claude: Created prompting framework that parsed documentation
and used Claude Models to generate wiki content.

Back-end Development of Wikif.ai: Added a suite of features to Wikif.ai with the usage of different AWS
services like Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, Bedrock, and Cognito.

React Front-end UI for Wikif.ai: Created a React UI for the Wikif.ai web application.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Industry · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · Generative AI Tools · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Skills: Python · Jenkins · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Terraform · Agile

positions.title: Student Developer
positions.description:
Created a Web App for Meta, Our Corporate Sponsor: I participated in a ten week program at Stanford
where I along with four other students worked alongside the NPE team at Meta to make a web app companion for their VR App Global History Archive where people would join live tours of famous sites on the Meta Quest hosted by professional tour guides. My team, Edventure, placed top 3 in the project fair at the end of the program.

Firebase Implementation of Edventure Web App: I was responsible for the fullstack development of the web app. I used Firebase, Google’s PaaS platform, to host the Edventure website that had Firebase RealtimeDB to support livestream, chat, and 3D model manipulation. I used Firebase Auth to provide Google signin and create profiles. The front-end was designed with React.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · HTML · Firebase · JavaScript

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on research project relating to electromagnetic wave propagation
- Utilized equipment such spectrum analyzer and RF generator to collect data
- Programming an algorithm to compute an equation that describes the propagation
- Collaborated with faculty and senior design students 
- Presented research results at a symposium in front of university faculty and company leaders

honors.title: Gates Scholarship
honors.description: A highly competitive scholarship that selects 300 out of well over 30,000 students to receive a scholarship from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Students are chosen for their academic excellence, potential for success, and leadership ability.
honors.issuer: Issued by Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation · May 2020

honors.title: Dell Scholarship
honors.description: This scholarship is awarded to students who demonstrate both merit and need. It awards a $20,000 dollar scholarship to its recipients as well as a Dell Laptop from the Michael & Susan Dell Foundation.
honors.issuer: Issued by Michael & Susan Dell Foundation · Apr 2020
